thread:
Riley (Sales): Kicking off scoping for client POC: embed + doc search with PII redaction. Need measurable success criteria, burst pricing, and security checklist.
Tess (SolutionsEng): Proposal: 450 golden prompts (real) + 3 paraphrases each -> ~1800 eval items. Primary metric: weighted pass rate >= 0.82. Also p95 latency < 350ms during normal load, and withstand 200 RPS 15m stress bursts.
Sam (ClientPOC): 200 RPS peak looks accurate for our internal peak window (09:30-10:00 PT). We can supply ~300 real sanitized examples.
Ibrahim (Security): We require proof of redaction before ingest. Acceptable options: customer-scrubbed CSV or our redaction pipeline run in their account. Also need customer KMS ARN for Dedicated/Private tests.
Maya (Pricing): For a short Dedicated test we can offer a 7-day reserved baseline + metered burst rate. I'll draft two options: flat test fee or capped spend commit for predictability.
Tess (SolutionsEng): Eval harness: pytest runner + scoring CLI. Suggested scoring weights: correctness 0.65, hallucination penalty 0.25, format 0.10. Automated checks + 10 human spot audits per run.
Sam (ClientPOC): On regression policy: we need automatic fallback for the POC route if metrics degrade. What are reasonable thresholds?
Tess (SolutionsEng): Recommend auto-fallback if weighted score drops >2% OR hallucination rate increases >4%. In either case, send human review ticket and keep logs (trace id + prompt hash) for debugging (no raw PII).
Ibrahim (Security): Agreed on logging constraints. We'll provide a hashing scheme and verification steps. Also request limited retention window for evaluation artifacts (30 days).
Riley (Sales): Timeline proposal: Day 0 kickoff + dataset handoff, Day 4 first baseline eval, Day 10 perf tuning + burst tests, Day 21 final report.
deploy-bot: Scheduled: sales-poc-canary on staging at 2025-01-15T14:00:00Z.
Maya (Pricing): Action: I'll circulate pricing appendix and a one-paragraph trial commitment.
Tess (SolutionsEng): Action: I'll share the eval harness link, a sample scoring config, and a small scrub notebook (today).
Sam (ClientPOC): I'll upload sanitized sample CSV and share KMS ARN via secure channel (EOD).
Riley (Sales): I'll draft SOW & milestone email and loop in legal for the trial clause. Thanks team!
